fusions.name: Snare Line
fusions.desc: Casts a line of strands from your shield's rim at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 11 damage, binding it for 1 second, and slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristling Flurry
fusions.desc: Shakes your shield and looses 5 stiffened strands, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Curtain of Locks
fusions.desc: Draws a curtain of strands around you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Woven Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. When you reach 10, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
